title: Launch runway and release coordination for Private/VPC security stack (RBAC, Audit Logs, KMS)
creator: Arielle Kwan
description:
Summary:
This ticket coordinates the cross-functional launch runway for the Private/VPC security feature set: RBAC, audit logging, and KMS integration. Objective is to produce a coordinated release that meets enterprise compliance expectations, has clear customer enablement materials, and includes robust release notes and rollback/runbook content.

Goals:
- Finalize release notes and TL;DR snippets for marketing, sales, and in-console UI.
- Produce a customer enablement kit: Quickstart (Terraform + Helm examples), migration checklist, and a recorded on-demand webinar.
- Align security/compliance artifacts (attestation checklist, SOC2/ISO mapping, KMS key rotation guidance).
- Ensure telemetry & SLOs are instrumented and dashboards created in Console.
- Define staged rollout with beta cohort, canary %, and fallback paths to hosted model variants.

Acceptance criteria:
- Release notes approved by PM and Legal for compliance wording.
- Enablement repo with sample Terraform + Helm modules published and linked in docs.
- Security review completed and evidence attached to release.
- Dedicated console dashboards for RBAC events and audit-log ingestion showing realistic test traffic.
- Customer migration checklist validated with 2 beta customers.
- Runbook and rollback plan reviewed with SRE and Support.

Deliverables: (owners listed)
- Release notes package: PM (Diego) + Legal review (Legal Team) + Localization brief (Docs).
- Enablement kit: Solutions Engineering (templates + terraform) + Developer Relations (sample apps).
- Compliance artifacts: Security (attestation checklist), Privacy (DPA notes).
- Observability: Metrics + Dashboards (Observability team), Alert rules (SRE).
- Release playbook: Rollout gates, canary percentages, rollback criteria, communication templates (PM).

High-level timeline:
- Week 1 (2025-02-12 to 2025-02-18): PM kickoff, feature signoff, security scope finalization.
- Week 2: Draft release notes, enablement templates, start security review.
- Week 3: Beta cohort onboarding, dashboards and test telemetry, draft runbook.
- Week 4 (target release week 2025-03-21): Final approvals, staged rollout begins.

Rollout plan:
- Phase 0: Internal dogfood + SRE smoke tests.
- Phase 1: Invite-only beta (5 customers) + runbook validation.
- Phase 2: Canary (10% of eligible private deployments) for 48h with automated health checks.
- Phase 3: Ramp to GA with customer communications and enablement webinar.
- Fallbacks: automatic circuit-breaker to hosted inference variant if RBAC/KMS errors exceed threshold, or rollback of KMS key policy changes.

Telemetry and SLOs:
- Track audit-log ingestion latency (p95 < 1s), RBAC evaluation latency (p95 < 20ms), KMS envelope errors and key access failed rate.
- Create Console dashboard: per-customer RBAC denies, audit-log volume, KMS requests and error codes.
- Alerting: SRE on-call if KMS error rate > 0.5% for 15m or audit-log ingestion backlog > 10k events.

Release notes coordination:
- Prepare 3 copies: external short-form, external detailed (docs + migration steps), internal engineering notes (breakdown of compatibility and mitigation).
- Use standardized bullets: what changed, why it matters, customer impact, migration steps, known limitations, rollback.
- Link examples: Confluence release draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PD/Private+Security+Stack+Release+Notes

Compliance & Security checklist:
- Security to produce attestation pack: threat model updates, KMS key management guidance, audit-log retention policy.
- Privacy & Legal: DPA implications for audit logs and encryption at rest.
- Post-release: schedule a 30-day compliance review to validate telemetry and audit evidence.

Customer enablement:
- Quickstart repo with Terraform and Helm samples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-deploy-quickstart (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-deploy-quickstart/pull/78)
- Migration checklist including test prompts, tokenization sanity checks, and KV cache considerations.
- Webinar date proposed: 2025-03-26; record and publish to enable self-serve onboarding.

Communications plan:
- Internal: #prod-private-launch Slack channel, weekly sync cadence with ENG/Security/Sales/SE.
- External: Customer beta emails, release blog post, in-console announcement for GA.
- Sales enablement: one-pager with migration effort estimate and common Q&A.

Open questions / risks:
- KMS key rotation semantics across on-prem replicas — ENG to confirm cross-region rotation behavior (ENG-18901).
- Audit-log schema and retention defaults for enterprise vs trial customers; legal signoff needed.
- Any additional regulatory packaging for EU customers (data residency proof).

Next steps:
- Diego to circulate release note draft by 2025-02-14.
- Schedule security review meeting for 2025-02-17.
- Solutions Engineering to publish initial quickstart PR by 2025-02-21.

References and artifacts:
- Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PD/Private+Security+Stack+Release+Notes
- Quickstart repo PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-deploy-quickstart/pull/78
- Draft runbook (internal): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1PrivateSecurityRunbook
